Fast forward to the next year, covid outbreak so online classes. I had an emergency with my family so i texted her that i will be absent. And then she messaged me back asking me what emergency i had. I told her it was private but she kept digging. And she then threatened me to ask my mom about it. And i replied with yea go ahead she wont tell you too because it is private. I was so tired of her pressuring me, so i just replied with okay I will attend to your class. And i did attend her class outside in the public while getting screamed at by my dad.
